GV.OC.objective: Ensure the business understands its mission, legal obligations, and stakeholder expectations so cybersecurity decisions support real business priorities.
kpis: Percent of critical business processes with a documented cybersecurity dependency mapped (target 100%)
Number of legal, regulatory, and contractual security requirements identified and tracked (target: complete register reviewed annually)

GV.OV.objective: Give leadership clear, regular visibility into cybersecurity risk so they can direct and adjust the strategy.
kpis: Percent of scheduled leadership cybersecurity reviews completed on time in the last 12 months (target 100%)
Number of days between a material risk change and its report to leadership (target 30 days or fewer)

GV.PO.objective: Establish and maintain written security policies that set clear expectations for how the organization protects its systems and data.
kpis: Percent of required security policies approved and reviewed within the last 12 months (target 100%)
Percent of employees who have acknowledged current security policies (target 95% or higher)

GV.RM.objective: Define how the organization decides which cybersecurity risks to accept, reduce, transfer, or avoid.
kpis: Percent of identified risks with a documented treatment decision and owner (target 100%)
Percent of risks reassessed within their defined review cycle (target 90% or higher)

GV.RR.objective: Assign clear cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authority so nothing critical falls through the cracks.
kpis: Percent of defined security responsibilities with a named, accountable owner (target 100%)
Percent of security roles reviewed and confirmed in the last 12 months (target 100%)

GV.SC.objective: Manage the cybersecurity risk that comes from vendors, suppliers, and third-party technology the business relies on.
kpis: Percent of critical vendors with a completed security assessment (target 100%)
Percent of vendor contracts that include required security and breach-notification terms (target 90% or higher)

ID.AM.objective: Maintain an accurate, current inventory of hardware, software, data, and services so the business can protect what it owns.
kpis: Percent of enterprise devices present in the asset inventory (target 95% or higher)
Percent of installed software recorded and approved in the software inventory (target 95% or higher)

ID.IM.objective: Learn from assessments, tests, and incidents to continuously improve the cybersecurity program.
kpis: Percent of improvement actions from reviews and incidents closed by their due date (target 90% or higher)
Number of lessons-learned reviews completed after significant incidents or exercises (target: one per qualifying event)

ID.RA.objective: Identify and analyze threats and vulnerabilities to understand the actual risk to the organization.
kpis: Percent of critical assets scanned for vulnerabilities on schedule (target 100%)
Median time to remediate critical vulnerabilities (target 30 days or fewer)

PR.AA.objective: Ensure only the right people and devices can access systems and data, with strong identity verification.
kpis: Percent of user accounts protected by multi-factor authentication (target 100% for privileged and remote access)
Percent of access rights reviewed and confirmed in the last 90 days (target 100% for privileged accounts)

PR.AT.objective: Give employees the awareness and training they need to recognize and avoid cybersecurity threats.
kpis: Percent of staff who completed required security awareness training in the last 12 months (target 95% or higher)
Simulated phishing click rate across the workforce (target 5% or lower)

PR.DS.objective: Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data at rest and in transit.
kpis: Percent of sensitive data stores with encryption enabled (target 100%)
Percent of critical data sets with tested, recoverable backups (target 100%)

PR.IR.objective: Build and maintain technology infrastructure that resists disruption and keeps critical services running.
kpis: Percent of critical systems with redundancy or failover in place (target 100%)
Percent of resilience or recovery tests passed against defined recovery-time targets (target 90% or higher)

PR.PS.objective: Keep platforms, devices, and software securely configured and patched to reduce the attack surface.
kpis: Percent of systems meeting the approved secure configuration baseline (target 90% or higher)
Percent of critical and high patches applied within the defined window (target 95% or higher)

RC.CO.objective: Communicate clearly with staff, customers, and stakeholders during recovery so trust and coordination are maintained.
kpis: Percent of recovery communications delivered within the timeframe set in the recovery plan (target 100%)
Percent of key stakeholder contacts verified as current in the last 12 months (target 100%)

RC.RP.objective: Restore affected systems and data quickly and correctly after an incident, following a tested recovery plan.
kpis: Percent of recovery objectives met during actual incidents or tests (target 90% or higher)
Percent of critical systems with a documented and tested recovery procedure (target 100%)

RS.AN.objective: Investigate incidents thoroughly to understand scope, root cause, and impact so response is effective.
kpis: Percent of incidents with a completed root-cause analysis (target 100% of significant incidents)
Median time to determine the scope and impact of an incident (target 24 hours or fewer)

RS.CO.objective: Coordinate incident response internally and externally, including required notifications to authorities and stakeholders.
kpis: Percent of incidents reported to required parties within mandated timeframes (target 100%)
Percent of incidents with response roles and communications executed per the plan (target 90% or higher)

RS.MA.objective: Manage incidents in a consistent, organized way from detection through closure.
kpis: Percent of incidents handled per the documented response plan (target 100%)
Median time from detection to containment (target 8 hours or fewer for high-severity incidents)

RS.MI.objective: Contain and neutralize incidents to limit their spread and reduce damage to the business.
kpis: Median time to contain a confirmed incident (target 4 hours or fewer for high-severity incidents)
Percent of incidents contained before spreading to additional systems (target 90% or higher)

DE.AE.objective: Analyze security alerts and events to accurately identify and prioritize genuine adverse events.
kpis: Percent of high-severity alerts triaged within the defined service target (target 95% or higher)
Percent of confirmed incidents that were first identified by internal detection (target 80% or higher)

DE.CM.objective: Continuously monitor networks, systems, and users to detect threats and unauthorized activity quickly.
kpis: Percent of critical assets under continuous monitoring (target 100%)
Percent of critical systems sending logs to centralized monitoring (target 95% or higher)

1.objective: Maintain an accurate, continuously updated inventory of every device connected to the business so nothing unknown can quietly become a foothold for attackers.
kpis: Percent of enterprise assets recorded in the authoritative inventory (target 95%+)
Frequency of inventory reconciliation against the live network (target at least monthly)
Time to detect and record a newly connected unauthorized device (target under 1 week)

2.objective: Know exactly what software runs across the business and block anything unapproved, shrinking the attack surface to only trusted, supported applications.
kpis: Percent of installed software captured in the authorized software inventory (target 95%+)
Percent of assets enforcing application allowlisting (target 90%+)
Number of unsupported or end-of-life applications still in use (target 0)

3.objective: Identify, classify, and safeguard sensitive data throughout its life so it is protected at rest, in transit, and when disposed of.
kpis: Percent of sensitive data stores that are classified and inventoried (target 90%+)
Percent of sensitive data encrypted at rest and in transit (target 100%)
Frequency of data access and retention review (target at least annually)

4.objective: Apply and maintain secure, hardened configurations on all devices and software so systems ship and stay in a defensible baseline rather than an insecure default.
kpis: Percent of assets built from an approved secure configuration baseline (target 95%+)
Percent of assets passing automated configuration compliance scans (target 90%+)
Percent of default and vendor accounts and passwords changed or disabled (target 100%)

5.objective: Manage the full lifecycle of user, administrator, and service accounts so only current, authorized people and systems hold credentials.
kpis: Percent of accounts tied to an active, authorized owner (target 100%)
Time to disable accounts after a person leaves or changes role (target under 24 hours)
Frequency of account inventory and access review (target at least quarterly)

6.objective: Grant, enforce, and revoke access rights based on least privilege and strong authentication so each account can reach only what its role requires.
kpis: Percent of remote and administrative access protected by multi-factor authentication (target 100%)
Percent of access grants reviewed and confirmed as least privilege (target 90%+)
Frequency of privileged access rights review (target at least quarterly)

7.objective: Continuously find and fix security weaknesses across systems and software before attackers can exploit them.
kpis: Mean time to remediate critical vulnerabilities (target under 15 days)
Frequency of authenticated vulnerability scans (target at least monthly)
Percent of assets covered by automated patch management (target 95%+)

8.objective: Collect, protect, and retain audit logs so security events can be detected, investigated, and reconstructed after an incident.
kpis: Percent of critical systems forwarding logs to central storage (target 95%+)
Log retention period met against policy (target at least 90 days)
Percent of time source clocks are synchronized for accurate timestamps (target 99%+)

9.objective: Reduce the risk from the two most common attack routes, email and web browsing, by filtering malicious content before it reaches users.
kpis: Percent of inbound email filtered for spam, phishing, and malicious attachments (target 100%)
Percent of endpoints enforcing DNS filtering or a web content filter (target 95%+)
Percent of browsers and email clients running a supported, patched version (target 95%+)

10.objective: Prevent, detect, and remove malicious software across the business so infections are stopped early and contained.
kpis: Percent of endpoints and servers running centrally managed anti-malware (target 100%)
Percent of anti-malware agents with current signatures or definitions (target 98%+)
Percent of removable media scanned automatically on connection (target 100%)

11.objective: Maintain reliable, tested backups so the business can recover its data and operations quickly after ransomware, failure, or disaster.
kpis: Percent of critical systems with automated backups on schedule (target 100%)
Frequency of successful backup restoration tests (target at least quarterly)
Percent of backups held offline, offsite, or immutable (target 100%)

12.objective: Securely design, configure, and manage network devices so the network itself does not become an easy path for attackers.
kpis: Percent of network devices running a supported, patched firmware version (target 95%+)
Percent of network device configurations reviewed against a secure baseline (target 90%+)
Frequency of network architecture and rule review (target at least annually)

13.objective: Monitor network traffic and defenses so suspicious activity and intrusions are detected and blocked in time to limit damage.
kpis: Percent of network segments covered by intrusion detection or monitoring (target 90%+)
Mean time to detect anomalous network activity (target under 24 hours)
Percent of critical alerts triaged within the defined service window (target 95%+)

14.objective: Build a security-aware workforce through training so employees recognize and resist phishing, social engineering, and unsafe behavior.
kpis: Percent of staff completing security awareness training on schedule (target 95%+)
Phishing simulation click rate (target under 5 percent)
Frequency of awareness training delivery (target at least annually)

15.objective: Assess and monitor third-party service providers so vendors handling business data or systems meet the security standards the business relies on.
kpis: Percent of service providers captured in the vendor inventory (target 100%)
Percent of critical providers assessed for security before or during onboarding (target 90%+)
Frequency of vendor security review (target at least annually)

16.objective: Build and maintain software securely so applications the business develops or operates do not introduce exploitable weaknesses.
kpis: Percent of in-house applications covered by security testing before release (target 90%+)
Mean time to remediate high-severity application vulnerabilities (target under 30 days)
Percent of developers trained in secure coding practices (target 90%+)

17.objective: Prepare, document, and practice an incident response process so the business can react quickly and consistently when a security event occurs.
kpis: Existence of a documented, current incident response plan with named roles (target yes, reviewed annually)
Frequency of incident response exercises or tabletops (target at least annually)
Mean time to contain a confirmed incident (target under 24 hours)

18.objective: Test defenses through simulated attacks so real-world weaknesses are found and fixed before adversaries exploit them.
kpis: Frequency of penetration testing on critical systems (target at least annually)
Mean time to remediate critical findings from penetration tests (target under 30 days)
Percent of prior test findings verified as remediated (target 90%+)
